author: feenberg
body:
How did you want to go with this? I have modified taxsim to allocate all deductions to the higher income partner when testing, but optimally in production. We shouldn't keep that difference into the future.  Here is my code for allocating deductions. 

            ```
diff=agit-agis
            dedt=min(dedex,diff)
            rest=dedex-dedt
            dedt=dedt+.5*rest
            deds=dedex-dedt
            taxint=agit-dedt
            taxins=agis-deds
```
agit, agis are agi of taxpayer and spouse. dedex is total deduction.
